method: Spearman IC between each context signal and the price return to the first log 30-40 days later; effective observations are non-overlapping one-month windows. Reporting only - nothing here moves a score.

distance_from_200d.positive_ic_means: stocks further above their 200-day average did better

distance_from_50d.positive_ic_means: stocks further above their 50-day average did better

ma_distance_21_200.positive_ic_means: stocks whose short average sat further above the long one did better

return_1m.positive_ic_means: last month's winners kept winning (negative = reversal)

return_5d.positive_ic_means: last week's winners kept winning (negative = reversal)

return_1m_vs_sector.definition: last month's return minus its sector's median (Da, Liu & Schaumburg 2014)
return_1m_vs_sector.positive_ic_means: sector-relative winners kept winning (negative = industry-relative reversal)

position_in_52w_range.positive_ic_means: stocks nearer their 52-week high did better

volume_ratio.positive_ic_means: heavier recent volume preceded better returns

options_expected_move.positive_ic_means: a bigger implied move preceded better returns

options_put_skew.positive_ic_means: steeper put skew preceded better returns (literature: worse)

options_put_call_oi.positive_ic_means: more put open interest preceded better returns

insider_buyers.definition: officers and directors buying in 90 days
insider_buyers.positive_ic_means: more insider buyers preceded better returns

insider_buy_value.definition: dollar value of insider purchases, 90 days
insider_buy_value.positive_ic_means: larger insider purchases preceded better returns
